facts.text: Undergraduate students under age 25 taking nine or more hours per semester are required to attend daily chapel held Monday through Friday at 9 a.m.
Harding requires every student enrolled in nine or more hours to enroll in and regularly attend one Bible class for at least two credit hours each fall and spring semester.
The Harding Guarantee is a last-dollar scholarship that pays 100% of remaining tuition costs for eligible students who qualify for the maximum Federal Pell Grant each year.
